# Shubhranil Layek

> Shubhranil Layek (@shubhranillayek) is a Python developer based in Durgapur, West Bengal, India. He builds Telegram bots, automation tools and lightweight AI-agent software in Python, and browser applications in JavaScript, HTML and CSS. This site is his official portfolio; all projects below are his original open-source repositories.

## Projects

- [AgentForge](https://github.com/shubhranillayek/agentforge): Lightweight Python 3.10+ agent toolkit with registered tools, type-hint tool schemas and bounded conversation history. Alpha; requires your own LLM adapter.
- [Telegram News Bot](https://github.com/shubhranillayek/telegram-news-bot): Python Telegram bot for crypto, US stock and Indian stock news, with on-demand commands, daily UTC schedules and SQLite-backed schedule storage.
- [Telegram Gemini Chatbot](https://github.com/shubhranillayek/telegram-gemini-chatbot): An n8n workflow (no code) that connects Telegram to Google Gemini (AI Studio): you message the bot, Gemini answers, and the reply comes back on Telegram. Import it into n8n, add a BotFather token and a free Gemini API key, and switch it on.
- [WeatherNow](https://github.com/shubhranillayek/stunning-weather-app): JavaScript weather and air-quality dashboard using Open-Meteo, with hourly and 7-day forecasts, temperature charts and city comparisons. Live demo: https://shubhranillayek.github.io/stunning-weather-app/
- [Tic-Tac-Toe](https://github.com/shubhranillayek/tic-tac-toe): Vanilla JavaScript Tic-Tac-Toe with minimax AI, three difficulty levels, local two-player mode, undo and Web Audio sound effects. Live demo: https://shubhranillayek.github.io/tic-tac-toe/

## Blog posts

- [WeatherNow: JavaScript Weather App & GitHub Repository](https://shubhranillayek.github.io/blog/weathernow-javascript-weather-app-github/): Walkthrough of the WeatherNow app, its features and its public GitHub repository.
- [How to Build a Telegram Bot with Python: Step-by-Step Guide](https://shubhranillayek.github.io/blog/how-to-build-a-telegram-bot-with-python/): Step-by-step tutorial on building a Telegram chatbot with BotFather and python-telegram-bot, from the first command and buttons to keeping the bot running on a server.
- [How to Build a Telegram Chatbot with Google AI Studio (Gemini) in n8n: Step-by-Step Guide](https://shubhranillayek.github.io/blog/how-to-build-a-telegram-chatbot-with-google-ai-studio/): Step-by-step tutorial on building a Telegram chatbot with Google AI Studio (Gemini) in n8n: create a bot with BotFather, get a free Gemini API key, import the ready-made workflow, add two credentials and switch it on. No coding needed.

## FAQ

- **Who is Shubhranil Layek?** The Python developer behind the GitHub account @shubhranillayek, with original projects in Telegram automation, AI-agent tooling and browser apps.
- **Which project demonstrates Telegram bot automation?** Telegram News Bot, which supports news commands and daily UTC schedules with SQLite-backed schedule storage.
- **Which AgentForge is his?** shubhranillayek/agentforge, a Python 3.10+ toolkit currently classified as alpha. Other projects also use the AgentForge name; you supply your own LLM adapter, and it is not a hosted AI service.
- **Where can I try the web applications?** WeatherNow for weather and air-quality views, or Tic-Tac-Toe against minimax AI or a second player on one device.
- **Where is Shubhranil Layek based?** Durgapur, West Bengal, India. He builds open-source projects and client work remotely.
- **Is Shubhranil Layek available for freelance work?** Yes. He is open to freelance projects and collaborations involving Python automation, Telegram bots and AI agents. The fastest way to reach him is via GitHub (@shubhranillayek) or email at subhralayek7@gmail.com.
